For the constructed format, see [[Premiere (format)]].

'''Premiere''' is the first expansion of Star Wars Customizable Card Game, published by [[Decipher]] in December 1995. Its 324-card pool appeared in English [[Premiere Limited|Limited]] and [[Premiere Unlimited|Unlimited]] editions and in [[Premiere (Japanese)|Japanese]].<ref name="collection">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Internet Archive] (4 May 1999).</ref><ref name="japan">[http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/japancoolstory.html Star Wars CCG in Japan], Rich Loftus, Decipher (1 April 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970607092233/http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/japancoolstory.html Internet Archive].</ref> The '''Premiere expansion family''' connects those editions with later reprints, promotional printings and [[Errata|errata]] of its cards.

== Reprints and related products ==
Premiere cards appeared in later fixed decks and foil releases. Other products contained randomized Premiere packs or starter decks. A product could do both: the two-player games contained fixed reprints and a separate Premiere booster, while the Reflections products combined selected foil printings with random cards from older sets.

=== Products containing Premiere packs or starters ===
These products supplied existing Premiere packs or randomized starter decks. Their Premiere contents were not a fixed list of individual cards.<ref name="collection" /><ref name="reprint-contents" />

{| class="wikitable"
! Product !! Premiere contents supplied separately
|-
| [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] || One Premiere booster, in addition to the fixed decks above; early boxes included Limited packs and later boxes included Unlimited packs.
|-
| [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game]] || One Premiere Unlimited booster, in addition to the fixed decks above.
|-
| [[First Anthology]] || Two Premiere Unlimited starter decks.
|-
| [[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]] || Four Premiere Unlimited boosters.
|-
| [[Second Anthology]] || Eight Premiere Unlimited boosters.
|-
| [[Enhanced Premiere]] || Four Premiere Unlimited boosters, alongside one new premium character. [[Luke With Lightsaber]] is a different card from [[Luke Skywalker]].
|-
| [[Reflections]], [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] and [[Reflections III]] || Random cards from older sets, including Premiere, alongside the products' foil and premium cards; these were loose cards rather than sealed Premiere boosters.
|}

=== Tournament and promotional printings ===
[[Promotional Foils]] includes Premiere reprints such as [[Alter (Light) (Promotional Foil)|Alter]], [[Sense (Light) (Promotional Foil)|Sense]] and [[It Could Be Worse (Promotional Foil)|It Could Be Worse]]. [[Corellian Corvette (Promotional Foil)|Corellian Corvette]] was distributed through more than one promotion. Its different distribution occasions do not make it a different printed card.<ref name="encyc" />

== Errata and later printings ==
Some Premiere cards received [[Errata|Decipher errata]] or later [[Errata|Players Committee errata]]. A later printed card can incorporate revised wording: the [[Luke Skywalker (Reflections Foil)|Reflections Luke foil]] uses “not at a Tatooine site” where the [[Luke Skywalker|original Limited card]] says “present at any non-Tatooine location”.<ref name="luke-faces">Printed faces: [[:File:Premiere-L-lukeskywalker-decipher-archive.gif|Premiere Limited Luke Skywalker]] and [[:File:Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-Foil-PSA.jpg|Reflections Luke Skywalker foil]].</ref>

Each card's Versions navigator connects its printings and errata. A foil's finish and its printed wording are separate features: [[Luke Skywalker (Reflections Foil)|the English Reflections foil]] and [[Luke Skywalker (Japanese Reflections III Foil)|the Japanese Reflections III foil]] have separate publication articles and release contexts.

== Later Virtual adaptations ==
Premiere cards also became underlying cards for [[Virtual Original]], [[Virtual Legacy]] and [[Virtual Modern]] designs. For example, the Premiere [[Luke Skywalker]] family links to [[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 1)|Original Virtual Set 1 Luke]], [[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Block 1)|Virtual Block 1 Luke]] and [[Luke Skywalker (V)|Virtual Set 0 Luke]]. These are Virtual publications in their own eras and sets.
